title: Banks Transfer of Assets and Liabilities Ordinance 1973

sections.shortTitle: Banks Transfer of Assets and Liabilities Ordinance 1973
sections.description:
Short title extent and commencement

ORDINANCE XXX OF 1973
ORDINANCE XXX OF 1973
BANKS (TRANSFER OF ASSETS AND LIABILITIES) ORDINANCE, 1973
1.
Short title, extent and commencement.‑(1)
This Ordinance may be called the Banks (Transfer of Assets and Liabilities)
Ordinance, 1973.
(2)
It extends to the whole of Pakistan.
(3)
It shall come into force at once.

sections.shortTitle: Banks Transfer of Assets and Liabilities Ordinance 1973
sections.description:
Definitions

ORDINANCE XXX OF 1973
ORDINANCE XXX OF 1973
BANKS (TRANSFER OF ASSETS AND LIABILITIES) ORDINANCE, 1973
2. Definitions.‑In this Ordinance
unless there is anything repugnant in the subject or context,‑
(i)
"National Bank of Pakistan" means the Bank established under section
3 of the National Bank of Pakistan Ordinance, 1949 (XIX of 1949) ;. and
(ii)
"specified offices and branches" means the offices and branches of
the Eastern Mercantile Bank Limited and the Eastern Banking Corporation Limited
specified in the Schedule.

sections.shortTitle: Banks Transfer of Assets and Liabilities Ordinance 1973
sections.description:
Ordinance to override other laws

ORDINANCE XXX OF 1973
ORDINANCE XXX OF 1973
BANKS (TRANSFER OF ASSETS AND LIABILITIES) ORDINANCE, 1973
3. Ordinance to override other laws.‑ The provisions of this Ordinance and
any rule or order made thereunder shall! have effect notwithstanding anything
contained in any other law for the time being in force, or in any contract,
agreement, award, memorandum, article or other instrument whatsoever.

sections.shortTitle: Banks Transfer of Assets and Liabilities Ordinance 1973
sections.description:
Vesting of specified offices and branches

ORDINANCE XXX OF 1973
ORDINANCE XXX OF 1973
BANKS (TRANSFER OF ASSETS AND LIABILITIES) ORDINANCE, 1973
4. Vesting of specified offices and branches.‑On the commencement of
this Ordinance. the undertakings of each of the specified offices and branches
shall stand transferred to, and vest in, the National Bank of Pakistan.
Explanation.‑The
undertaking of a specified office or branch shall, subject to an order under
section 6, be deemed to include all assets, rights, powers, authorities and
privileges and all property, movable and immovable, ,cash balances, reserve
funds, investments and all other rights and interests in, or arising out of,
such property as were immediately before the commencement of this Ordinance in
the possession, ownership, power or control or the specified office or branch
in relation to the undertaking within Pakistan, or in relation to the business
of such undertaking outside Pakistan. and all books of accounts, registers,
records, and all other documents of whatever nature relating thereto, and shall
also be deemed to include except as herein after provided, all borrowings,
liabilities and obligations of whatever kind then subsisting of the specified
office or branch in relation to the undertaking within the Federal Capital and
the Provinces of the Punjab and Sind.

sections.shortTitle: Banks Transfer of Assets and Liabilities Ordinance 1973
sections.description:
Contracts and proceedings

ORDINANCE XXX OF 1973
ORDINANCE XXX OF 1973
BANKS (TRANSFER OF ASSETS AND LIABILITIES) ORDINANCE, 1973
5.
Contracts and proceedings.‑41) Unless otherwise expressly provided in
this Ordinance, ail contracts, deeds, bonds, agreements, powers of attorney,
grants of legal representation and other instruments of whatever nature
subsisting or having effect immediately before the commencement of this
Ordinance and to which any of the specified offices and branches is a party or
which are fn favour of any specified office or branch shall be of as fall force
and effect against or in favour of the National Bank of Pakistan, and may be
enforced or acted upon as fully and effectually, as if in the place of the
specified office or branch the National Bank of Pakistan had been a party thereto
or as if the same had been issued in favour of the National Bank of Pakistan.
(2)
If any suit, appeal or other proceeding of whatever nature in relation to any
business of the undertaking which is transferred by virtue of section 4 is
pending by or against any specified office or branch, the same shall not abate,
be discontinued or be in any way prejudicially affected by reason of the
transfer or of anything contained in this Ordinance, but the suit, appeal or
other proceeding may be continued, prosecuted and enforced by or against the
National Bank of Pakistan.

sections.shortTitle: Banks Transfer of Assets and Liabilities Ordinance 1973
sections.description:
Excepted liabilities

ORDINANCE XXX OF 1973
ORDINANCE XXX OF 1973
BANKS (TRANSFER OF ASSETS AND LIABILITIES) ORDINANCE, 1973
6.
Excepted liabilities.‑Notwithstanding anything contained in this
Ordinance the Federal Government may by order direct that any borrowings,
liabilities or obligations specified in such order shall not form part of the
undertaking of a specified office or branch transferred by virtue of section 4.

sections.shortTitle: Banks Transfer of Assets and Liabilities Ordinance 1973
sections.description:
Delivery of undertaking

ORDINANCE XXX OF 1973
ORDINANCE XXX OF 1973
BANKS (TRANSFER OF ASSETS AND LIABILITIES) ORDINANCE, 1973
7.
Delivery of undertaking.‑Where any part of the undertaking of a specified
office or branch Is in the possession or under the control of any person, such
person shall, within seven days of the commencement of this Ordinance, deliver
the same to a representative of the National Bank of Pakistan duly authorised
in that behalf.

sections.shortTitle: Banks Transfer of Assets and Liabilities Ordinance 1973
sections.description:
Police assistance

ORDINANCE XXX OF 1973
ORDINANCE XXX OF 1973
BANKS (TRANSFER OF ASSETS AND LIABILITIES) ORDINANCE, 1973
8.
Police assistance.‑It shall be lawful for a police officer to seize any
property forming part of the undertaking of a specified office or branch and
for a Magistrate, by warrant, to authorise any police officer not below the
rank of Inspector to enter upon and search for any property of the under taking
of a specified office or branch in any premises where it may reasonably be
expected to be found and upon seizure thereof to deliver the same to the
National Bank of Pakistan.

sections.shortTitle: Banks Transfer of Assets and Liabilities Ordinance 1973
sections.description:
Evaluation

ORDINANCE XXX OF 1973
ORDINANCE XXX OF 1973
BANKS (TRANSFER OF ASSETS AND LIABILITIES) ORDINANCE, 1973
9.
Evaluation.‑(1) The National Bank of Pakistan shall cause the assets and
liabilities of the specified offices and branches to be evaluated and such
evaluation to be duly audited by any auditor who is a chartered accountant
within the meaning of the Chartered Accountants Ordinance, 1961 (X of 1961).
(2)
The report of an evaluation under subsection (1) duly audited as required by
that subsection, shall disclose the financial status of each of the specified
offices and branches as at the date of transfer under section 4, and shall be
submitted to the Federal Government within three months of such slate.
(3)
The Federal Government may, by order, Issue directions as to the manner in
which any excess of assets over liabilities or any shortfall therein of the
specified offices and branches as at the date of the transfer by virtue of
section 4 is to be disposed of or recovered, as the case may be.

sections.shortTitle: Banks Transfer of Assets and Liabilities Ordinance 1973
sections.description:
Employments

ORDINANCE XXX OF 1973
ORDINANCE XXX OF 1973
BANKS (TRANSFER OF ASSETS AND LIABILITIES) ORDINANCE, 1973
10. Employment.‑(1) Notwithstanding
anything contained in section 5, all service contracts of officers and other
employees with the specified offices and branches shall stand terminated upon
the commencement of this Ordinance and no such officer or other employee shall
be entitled to any compensation on account of such termination ; and no claim
for any such compensation shall be entertained by any Court, tribunal or other
authority;
Provided
that the National Bank of Pakistan may require any officer or other employee of
any of the specified offices and branches to perform any such function In
relation to an undertaking of the specified office or branch as the Bank may
direct, for such period and on such terms and conditions as the Bank may
determine.
(2)
If the National Bank of Pakistan decides to retain the services of any officer
or other employee of any of the specified offices and branches, it may enter
into fresh contracts of employment with him without entitling such officer or
other employee to any benefits in respect of his previous service with the
specified office or branch.

sections.shortTitle: Banks Transfer of Assets and Liabilities Ordinance 1973
sections.description:
Validity of action of officers of specified offices and branches

ORDINANCE XXX OF 1973
ORDINANCE XXX OF 1973
BANKS (TRANSFER OF ASSETS AND LIABILITIES) ORDINANCE, 1973
11.
Validity of action of officers of specked
offices and branches.‑Not withstanding any cancellation of powers
delegated by the managements of the Eastern
Bank Limited and the Eastern Banking Corporation Limited to be officers of the
specified offices and branches, all actions taken by such officers in good
faith between the 16th day of December 1971, and the date of transfer of the
undertakings of such offices and branches by virtue of section 4 shall be
deemed to have been validly taken and shall have effect as if there had been no
such cancellation of powers.

sections.shortTitle: Banks Transfer of Assets and Liabilities Ordinance 1973
sections.description:
Extension of limitation

ORDINANCE XXX OF 1973
ORDINANCE XXX OF 1973
BANKS (TRANSFER OF ASSETS AND LIABILITIES) ORDINANCE, 1973
12.
Extension of limitation.‑For the purpose of computing the period of
limitation for the recovery of any money due to or from any of the specified
offices and branches the period between the 16th December 1971, and the date of
transfer of the undertakings of the specified offices and branches by virtue of
section 4 shall be excluded.

sections.shortTitle: Banks Transfer of Assets and Liabilities Ordinance 1973
sections.description:
References in other laws

ORDINANCE XXX OF 1973
ORDINANCE XXX OF 1973
BANKS (TRANSFER OF ASSETS AND LIABILITIES) ORDINANCE, 1973
13.
References in other laws.‑Any
reference to any of the specified offices and branches 9n any law, other than
this Ordinance or in any contract or other instrument shall, in so far as it
relates to any of the under takings transferred by virtue of section 4 and if
not inconsistent with any provision of this Ordinance be construed as a
reference to the National Bank of Pakistan.

sections.shortTitle: Banks Transfer of Assets and Liabilities Ordinance 1973
sections.description:
Penalties

ORDINANCE XXX OF 1973
ORDINANCE XXX OF 1973
BANKS (TRANSFER OF ASSETS AND LIABILITIES) ORDINANCE, 1973
14.
Penalties.‑Any person who contravenes any of the provisions of this
Ordinance, or of any rule or order made thereunder or wilfully obstructs any
person in carrying out the purposes of this Ordinance, shall be punishable with
imprisonment for a term which may extend to three years, or with fine, or with
both.
sections.punishment:
punishable with
imprisonment for a term which may extend to three years, or with fine, or with
both.

sections.shortTitle: Banks Transfer of Assets and Liabilities Ordinance 1973
sections.description:
Bar of jurisdiction

ORDINANCE XXX OF 1973
ORDINANCE XXX OF 1973
BANKS (TRANSFER OF ASSETS AND LIABILITIES) ORDINANCE, 1973
15.
Bar of Jurisdiction.‑(1) No Court shall call‑in question, or permit
to be called in question, any thing done or action taken or purporting to be
done or taken under this Ordinance.
(2)
No Court s)all grant any injunction or make any order nor shall any Court
entertain any proceedings, in relation to any thing done or Intended or
purporting to be done under this Ordinance.

sections.shortTitle: Banks Transfer of Assets and Liabilities Ordinance 1973
sections.description:
Indemnity

ORDINANCE XXX OF 1973
ORDINANCE XXX OF 1973
BANKS (TRANSFER OF ASSETS AND LIABILITIES) ORDINANCE, 1973
16. Indemnity.‑No suit,
prosecution or other legal proceeding shall lie against the Federal Government
or the National Bank of Pakistan or any other person for anything in good faith
done or intended or purporting to be done under this Ordinance.

sections.shortTitle: Banks Transfer of Assets and Liabilities Ordinance 1973
sections.description:
Power to make rules

ORDINANCE XXX OF 1973
ORDINANCE XXX OF 1973
BANKS (TRANSFER OF ASSETS AND LIABILITIES) ORDINANCE, 1973
17.
Power to make rules.‑The
Federal Government may, by notification In the official Gazette, make such
rules as appear to it necessary or expedient for carrying out the purposes of
this Ordinance.

sections.shortTitle: Banks Transfer of Assets and Liabilities Ordinance 1973
sections.description:
Removal of difficulties

ORDINANCE XXX OF 1973
ORDINANCE XXX OF 1973
BANKS (TRANSFER OF ASSETS AND LIABILITIES) ORDINANCE, 1973
18.
Removal of difficulties.‑If any difficulty
arises in giving effect to any provision of this Ordinance, the Federal
Government may make such order, not inconsistent with the provisions of this
Ordinance, as may appear to it to be necessary or expedient for the purpose of
removing the difficulty.
